$comment: Our own CI (eCode): the light checks. Tests need no model. llama.cpp (inference) is built by .github/workflows/ci.yml on hosted runners, Linux included: it is too heavy for a shared machine.
name: ecode

steps.name: Test without inference
steps.run:
export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH"
cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets --no-default-features --features a2ui-gen-eui/download,a2ui-gen-eui-mcp/http -- -D warnings
cargo test --locked --workspace --no-default-features --features a2ui-gen-eui/download,a2ui-gen-eui-mcp/http
